honest_summary: All 25 slice files exist at the mapped paths and are real ports: every significant TypeScript export has a Rust counterpart with the same names, constants, error strings and ordering. Three files are partial: clipboard-native (no Rust binding for the @mariozechner/clipboard addon, so it is always absent and callers fall back), photon (the WASM readFileSync patch has no Rust analogue; decode/encode/resize use the image crate), fs-watch (polling stands in for node fs.watch events). Untested behaviour: anything needing a real terminal clipboard, a real GitHub download, a real WASM photon module, or a non-Windows host for the win32 branches; those paths are ported but not exercised.
